request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:WINDMILL

layers.text: Style: flat-shaded minimalist pixel art for a turn-based strategy board game map, like a tiny simple board-game building token: very simple blocky shapes, large areas of one flat muted colour, at most one slightly darker shadow tone per material, no texture and no small details, calm low contrast, a pale desaturated palette; it must stay quiet behind the game's units.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thick black outline, black outline, individual bricks, individual roof tiles, shingles, wood grain, cracks, highlights, glossy, low-poly 3D, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Class: one single small building map piece with a simple clear silhouette, flat colours and a thin outline in a darker tone of each colour (never black), big simple shapes, no decoration. It stands directly on the empty transparent background with no ground, soil, grass or platform under it; the bottom of the building is the lowest thing in the image. Its materials and colours are the ones the subject names; every colour is muted and a little pale, each material shaded with one slightly darker tone of its own colour. No flag, no banner and nothing painted in a team colour.
layers.negative: pedestal, base, plinth, round base, disc, rim, ground plate, platform, terrain slab, dirt slab, grass square, isometric block, ground tile, grass, soil, scenery, background, people, crowd, second building, flag, banner, pennant, heraldry, bright red, neon, saturated colours, soldier, person, character

layers.text: Subject: a steam pump house: one squat round boiler tower of riveted copper on a short grey stone footing, with a domed copper top, one white-faced pressure gauge, a tall dark iron chimney puffing one small puff of white steam, and one big brass cog wheel turning on its side beside a thick copper pipe; chunky and low. Buildings only.
The building is drawn large and fills most of the image, touching neither edge.
layers.negative: windmill, sails, blades, propeller, wood, plaster, terracotta, thatch, dwarf, face, eyes
